quote.text: Въпросът не е, че разполагаме с малко време. Въпросът е, че прекалено много го губим
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that every shared moment with your children is precious; do not let the trivial or fleeting distract you from nurturing their minds and hearts.
    • Embrace the wisdom of mindful presence—invest time intentionally in teaching and learning, as every passing minute is an opportunity to build lasting values.
  • Leadership:
    • Just as the Stoics teach us to measure the quality of our time, lead by example by investing your energy in actions that foster genuine progress and unity among your followers.
    • Reflect on each decision with the awareness that wasting time can never be recaptured; prioritize clarity of vision and purposeful action for the benefit of all.
  • Product Management:
    • In the realm of products and innovation, be mindful that every sprint and meeting should drive value; allocate resources in a way that avoids needless delays and wastes none of the potential time.
    • Like the wise Stoic, evaluate every project milestone with care—recognize that the true measure of success lies in making the best use of the limited time you have to deliver outstanding results.
